claims.text: Schinasi describes Kabul’s Durrani capital; FBR describes Peshawar salt contracts and later British regional salt administration. The 1893 reprint prescribes non-interference and joint demarcation, not these offices. Court, revenue institution and frontier undertaking are different powers; neither administrative change nor a ruler’s signature establishes all communities’ consent or current title.
